name: init
description: Establish and converge on a shared repository overview before task-specific planning.

steps.action: Survey the repository and draft the repo-summary artifact.
Review the current repo-summary artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Reviewer feedback into the repo-summary artifact.
Review the updated repo-summary artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Builder feedback into the repo-summary artifact.
Evaluate whether the current inquiry pass reached consensus.
Finalize and persist the repo-summary artifact.

name: plan
description: Author, review, and lock task-specific build and review plans through the Plan-Review Gate.

steps.action: Author the build-plan and review-plan artifacts for the task.
Submit build-plan and review-plan artifacts to Reviewer for gate review.
Inspect build-plan and review-plan artifacts for clarity, feasibility, scope boundaries, and verification criteria.
Revise build-plan and review-plan artifacts based on Reviewer feedback.
Finalize approved plans and prepare for blind handover.

name: build
description: Execute blind handover, perform mandatory alignment, implement minimal changes, and verify locally.

steps.action: Dispatch the approved build-plan artifact to Builder via blind handover, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.
Initiate implementation alignment with Planner regarding intent, scope, and edge cases before editing code.
Answer alignment inquiries and confirm scope boundaries and self-testing expectations.
Implement minimal required changes strictly within allowed files and verify with local automated tests.
Hand off the verified working copy diff and test execution logs to Planner without committing.
Inspect the working copy diff against declared in-scope boundaries, execute the atomic Conventional Commit under Planner VCS governance, and advance to the next step or conclude build.

name: review
description: Independently inspect code diff, execute TDD issue reproduction and fix loop, and resolve escalations.

steps.action: Forward Builder's code diff to Reviewer for verification against the review-plan artifact.
Inspect code diff against the review-plan artifact for scope compliance, correctness, and test adequacy.
Forward actionable review-findings to Builder, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.
Reproduce reported review-findings using TDD reproduction tests and evaluate outcome.
Fix implementation until all tests pass (Green), and report resolved diff and test logs to Planner.
Summarize review results, confirm acceptance criteria satisfaction, and conclude the task.
Arbitrate escalation with Reviewer (clarify/waive false positive, or evaluate scope change/plan update for unexpected error).
End the current review cycle and return to the plan flow to revise the task plans.
